### Environment

Windows version, Python version and commit or release tested.

### Result

Which step did you reach? Include the final pixel-check line or the command and first error message. Remove personal paths from logs.

### Visual or setup observation

What did you expect and what happened? For a visual issue, give the location in the radio image and the zoom level. If everything worked, a one-line confirmation is enough. Attach only the public radio demo or original artwork you can share.
